cards.coupling_name: Geodynamo → animal magnetoreception as a live time series
cards.physical_channel: geomagnetic field sourced in deforming inner core + outer-core flow, read by animal magnetoreceptors
cards.hypothesis: After removing solar-storm (Dst/Kp/AE), meteorological, and anthropogenic confounds, residual variance in animal navigation-failure and vagrancy time series covaries with geomagnetic secular-variation jerks and published inner-core seismic-waveform change epochs (including 2004–2008 Vidale window and later rotation-pause reports).

datasets.name: INTERMAGNET observatory network
datasets.coverage: global geomagnetic components, minutes to decades

datasets.name: Movebank / ICARUS animal-tracking archives
datasets.coverage: birds, bats, marine mammals; uneven but multi-decadal

datasets.name: Inner-core seismic waveform change epochs
datasets.coverage: sparse: South Sandwich → Alaska/Canada paths; discrete papers
datasets.url_or_source: Vidale et al. Nature Geoscience 2025; earlier Yang & Song / Wang rotation papers

datasets.name: Homing-pigeon racing loss records
datasets.coverage: clubs, incomplete, historically noted around solar storms
datasets.url_or_source: national pigeon-racing unions; would need data-use agreements

cards.primary_outcome: Weekly-to-monthly anomaly index of (a) migratory heading residual vs great-circle to stopover, (b) stranding count residual vs seasonal baseline, aligned to geomagnetic jerk dates and inner-core epochs.
controls: Kp, Dst, AE (solar storms — the known spoken confound)
ERA5 wind, precipitation, SST, NAO/ENSO indices
shipping density / seismic survey calendars (for whales)
confounds: Solar storms already affect pigeons and possibly whales — any core-sourced signal is a RESIDUAL after this.
Stranding databases are spatially biased; do not interpret geography of reports as geography of deaths.
Inner-core epochs are few (N small). Risk of p-hacking a handful of famous dates.
Magnetoreceptor identity still unknown; a null does not disprove magnetoreception, only this coupling.
cards.null_statement: Null: no residual covariance between navigation-failure/stranding anomalies and inner-core / secular-jerk epochs after solar and meteorological controls (partial r consistent with 0; pre-registered).
cards.minimum_detectable_effect: With ~20 years of weekly Movebank + stranding series and ~5 documented core/jerk epochs, the design is powered only for a LARGE residual (Cohen d ≳ 0.6 around epoch windows). Small effects will be invisible. That is acceptable: a coupling worth claiming should not be a tiny residual.
cards.pre_registration_notes: Freeze epoch list BEFORE looking at animal residuals. Epochs: Vidale 2004–2008 waveform-change window; published inner-core rotation-pause interval (early 2010s–2020s literature); known geomagnetic jerks (e.g. 1969, 1978, 1991, 1999, 2014, 2017+ as catalogued). Do not add epochs post hoc. One-tailed tests forbidden. Multiple-comparison correction across three animal classes (birds, turtles, whales).
cards.would_count_as_success: Pre-registered residual association survives solar+weather controls in at least two independent animal classes, with the same sign relative to jerk polarity, and fails a negative-control (randomized epoch times).
cards.would_count_as_failure: No residual, or residual that disappears when Kp/Dst is included. That is the expected outcome and would still be a result: it would kill this gap and return magnetoreception to ecology+solar weather. FAILURE IS THE HONEST BASE RATE.
cards.ethical_constraints: Observational only. No new capture. Stranding records are of dead or distressed animals; do not imply causation in public communication even if residual is real, until replication.

cards.coupling_name: Ultraweak photon emission as detector-noise cousin, not communication
cards.physical_channel: photons at 10–1000 s^-1 cm^-2 plus the contamination budget of rare-event photon counting
cards.hypothesis: Cell-state classification from UPE spectra fails once shielding and delayed-luminescence protocols match SuperCDMS/TESSERACT-class contamination control.

datasets.name: Published UPE cancer-vs-normal small-N optical counts
datasets.url_or_source: scattered UPE/biophoton papers (Popp lineage and later biomedical UPE)

datasets.name: Rare-event detector noise cookbooks
datasets.url_or_source: Mahapatra Applied Physics Letters 2025; SuperCDMS / TESSERACT technical notes

cards.primary_outcome: Blinded AUC for cell-state from UPE under physics-grade shielding vs under typical biology-lab shielding.
confounds: almost all positive UPE-biomarker claims use shielding that a dark-matter group would reject
cards.null_statement: Null: AUC indistinguishable from 0.5 under physics-grade shielding.
cards.minimum_detectable_effect: AUC >= 0.75 pre-registered, N sufficient for 80% power, independent replication lab.
cards.pre_registration_notes: Shielding protocol written by a rare-event physicist, not the UPE team.
cards.would_count_as_success: AUC holds under physics-grade shielding. Still NOT proof of communication — only of a biomarker.
cards.would_count_as_failure: Signal vanishes under proper shielding — UPE literature's biomedical claims were contamination. This is the base-rate expectation.
cards.ethical_constraints: Cell culture / discarded tissue only unless separately consented.

cards.coupling_name: Gut microbial dark matter as control for inaccessibility
cards.physical_channel: unmatched ORFs / uncultured lineages in metagenomes
cards.hypothesis: Unmatched-ORF fraction remains high in both human gut (hyper-sampled) and deep subsurface (hypo-sampled) after the same pipeline, implying darkness is methodological not geographic.

datasets.name: Deep biosphere MAG catalogues (IODP, terrestrial mines, DCO follow-ons)
datasets.coverage: sparse relative to gut but growing

cards.primary_outcome: Fraction of ORFs with no hit above a frozen bit-score threshold, same assembler/annotator, gut vs subsurface.
confounds: database contamination; gut databases are circularly trained on guts so gut 'known' fraction is inflated
cards.null_statement: Null of the CONTROL reading: gut unmatched << subsurface unmatched. If that null holds, darkness IS inaccessibility.
cards.minimum_detectable_effect: A 2× difference in unmatched fraction after rarefaction.
cards.pre_registration_notes: Freeze the reference DB date. Do not update UniProt mid-analysis.
cards.would_count_as_success: Gut unmatched remains high and comparable — darkness is culture/database, not caves.
cards.would_count_as_failure: Gut is nearly fully named, subsurface is not — then 'dark biosphere' really does mean 'far away'.
cards.ethical_constraints: Human gut data already de-identified in public catalogues; do not re-identify.

runnable_today: Geodynamo → animal magnetoreception as a live time series
Ultraweak photon emission as detector-noise cousin, not communication
Gut microbial dark matter as control for inaccessibility
meta.insight: All three top structural gaps are runnable on public data. The capability gap is not 'we need a new telescope'. It is that nobody has pre-registered these residual tests. That is an institutional failure, not an instrumental one.
